target_fidelity.note: It is a present simple, active, negative declarative with no modal.

grammaticality.note: “Mia does not drink coffee.” is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The context and completed sentence are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It gives focused practice of present-simple negation with does not.

determinacy.note: The cue and context clearly support the expected negative completion; the listed contracted and uncontracted forms cover the standard responses.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and unambiguous.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt supplies only the base-verb cue, not the completed negative form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Only basic present-simple negation and subject–auxiliary agreement are needed.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external factual or specialist knowledge is required.
